deployment.rule: the better of SAC and TQC by three-seed mean success on test set v4; within it, the seed with the best validation-set score (decision 2026-10-10)
deployment.note_threshold: TQC seed 2 must succeed in more than this many of the 1,000 test episodes for TQC's three-seed mean to exceed SAC's

notes.rppo_seed1_collapse: RecurrentPPO seed 1 collapsed mid-training: between 1.0 and 2.4 M steps, 258 of 273 updates stopped at the first epoch on the KL limit, the validation-set score fell to -0.91 at 2.0 M, and it recovered after 2.4 M. No defect was found, so the seed is kept and reported beside seeds 0 and 2, which show none of it (seed retention, skeleton S16; planning/PAPER3_CLAIMS_AND_TABLES.md).
notes.channel_widths: Decoupled channel cells: recorded nominal widths 6.9-10.6 m (median 8.7 m); 16 of 240 below 7.60 m.
